name: 98329 · Gig Harbor, WA
findings: ZIP 98329 (Gig Harbor) has 14 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (60% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98329 (Gig Harbor) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 98329 (Gig Harbor) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 22% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 21% of all organizations here have no identified type.
